Book Review - Designing your Second Life

Andy CASA, UCL East

Designing your Second Life by Rebecca Tapley is one of those books we wish we had before we started building in Second Life. It provides an almost essential guide to the ins and outs of avatar creation and perhaps more importantly architectural construction in the virtual environment.

Starting out in Second Life can be confusing in terms of learning how to claim land, place your first objects and learning how to use textures. Rebecca provides a step by step walk through of the process starting off with a basic house through to full landscaping and a castle.

If you are new to Second Life or looking to start building or buying land then Designing Your Second Life is the perfect accompaniment.

You can buy Designing Your Second Life from our Amazon Store at the discounted price of $19.99.

See also Second Life - The Official Guide.

Note a UK friendly store is coming soon...
